info.title: Server Fleet current HTTP additions — audit R34 candidate
info.description: Additive documentation of previously uncovered current route declarations. Not G2 freeze or production certification. Alias references and all source declarations are indexed in docs/api/ROUTES.md. Existing candidates and source archives remain byte-identical.

post.summary: Issue a restricted read token once
post.description: Cookie session plus CSRF. This management endpoint cannot itself use Bearer. The current Controller routes do not compose a Bearer read adapter; issuance is not proof that nodes/tasks HTTP accepts the token. Scope, epoch and read-cap enforcement ports exist, pending HTTP composition.
Requires workflows.write and every step target/action grant. Enabled defaults true. Parameters are a bounded string map. No direct Agent execution; tasks and their approvals remain authoritative.

post.summary: Match an event and advance the workflow
post.description: Requires current workflow write and per-target grants. Mismatched kind or event filters return matched:false/run:null. Matching steps submit unified tasks; pending task/approval is not completion.

patch.description: Requires current node-scoped gateway write permission. state takes precedence when both fields are supplied; expectedRevision guards concurrent updates. Pausing scheduling does not stop the existing nginx process.

post.description: Requires dns.account.default and current identity. Updates default account metadata; does not itself mutate provider DNS records. First provider remains Cloudflare.

patch.summary: Request plugin activation or a no-op
patch.description: Administrator Cookie/CSRF required. Matching current enabled state may return an audited no-op. Actual state changes return 501 PLUGIN_RUNTIME_UNAVAILABLE in the current profile; package installation is not runtime admission.

501.description: PLUGIN_RUNTIME_UNAVAILABLE; do not treat it as enabled.

post.description: Requires current publishing scope and referenced targets. Returns persisted operation and stages; cancellation is not rollback and does not erase previous side effects. Legacy /publishing/publications alias has identical handler semantics.

get.summary: Read installed and enabled declarative plugin status
get.description: Administrator Cookie session and installed+enabled lifecycle gates required. Reports metadata only; declarative:true is not evidence of an admitted Xray runtime or observed running service.
Public liveness only; runtime quarantine may return 503. Not an authorization, readiness, source-node or deployment health proof.
